# Project Title *(Example: Network Monitoring Tool Development)*

# Risk Identification

| Risk Description | Likelihood (Low/Medium/High) | Impact (Low/Medium/High) | Priority (Low/Medium/High) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Example: Delayed access to testing tools | Medium | High | High |

# Mitigation Strategies

| Risk Description | Mitigation Strategy | Owner | Deadline |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Example: Delayed access to testing tools | Ensure tools are requested 2 weeks in advance | Pat Doe | 2 weeks before milestone 2 |

# Monitoring Plan

* Outline how risks will be monitored throughout the project.  
  * Example: Weekly check-ins to review risk status.

# Contingency Plan

* Describe contingency actions if mitigation fails.  
  * Example: Use alternative tools if primary testing tools are unavailable.
